question: In renal cell carcinoma studies using ICI+Anti-VEGF, list the specific anti-VEGF agent(s) from the treatment regimen.
gt_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "Trial name", "Treatment regimen" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Renal cell' AND "Type of combination" = 'ICI+Anti-VEGF';
